context_doc.content:
# Platform Engineering Context

Sample-only context for Acme Systems. Current focus: reduce CI queue time, document service ownership, and preserve evidence for workflow reviews.

No real customer data, credentials, private repositories, or production endpoints are included.

sections.title: Purpose
sections.body: Keep platform reliability work, developer tooling notes, and evidence-backed run records together.

sections.title: Current Work
sections.body: Review a synthetic CI queue bottleneck and produce a read-only recommendation packet.

sections.title: First Blocker
sections.body: Execution is blocked because no sandbox write approval has been granted.

blockers.summary: Sandbox account is read-only; Code Worker cannot apply patches or run production CI.

context_doc.content:
# AI Coding Budget Review Context

Sample-only context for reviewing simulated AI coding usage. The review separates local work from hosted capacity and marks hosted execution as approval-required.

sections.title: Purpose
sections.body: Help reviewers understand what ran locally, what would require hosted approval, and where evidence is missing.

sections.title: Budget Boundary
sections.body: Hosted capacity is not enabled by default in this sandbox fixture.

blockers.summary: Usage totals are synthetic and cannot be used for billing decisions.

qa.name: Fixture does not claim billing-grade usage proof

spaces.name: Security Review

spaces.summary: Demonstrate evidence-backed security review without exposing private data or secrets.

context_doc.name: security-review-context.md
context_doc.content:
# Security Review Context

Sample-only context. Secrets, private files, raw telemetry, and production customer data are intentionally absent. Vault references are metadata-only.

sections.title: Security Boundary
sections.body: Ordinary memory must not store credentials. Secret-like material routes Vault-first.

sections.title: Unavailable States
sections.body: No production Palantir systems, customer files, or external secrets are connected in this sandbox.

blockers.summary: External system calls are unavailable without explicit credentials and approval.

qa.name: Sample data contains no real secrets
